# Sweepr for Cleaners

> clean.getsweepr.com (and dashboard.getsweepr.com) is Sweepr's app for
> professional cleaners: jobs, schedule, earnings, and training. Almost all
> of it requires a signed-in cleaner account; the public surface is the
> cleaner sign-up (recruiting) page.

## Key pages

- [Become a cleaner](https://clean.getsweepr.com/sign-up): Apply to become a Sweepr cleaner.
- [Sign in](https://clean.getsweepr.com/sign-in): Sign in to an existing cleaner account.
- [Sweepr marketing site](https://getsweepr.com/clean-with-us): How to apply and start earning as a Sweepr cleaner.
